description: The one emoji picker of the Notion editor. Search filters the grid, recent emoji render first, arrow keys move a single roving tabindex, and Escape closes it. ShowRemove adds the Remove action.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: Fixed top position in CSS pixels.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: Fixed left position in CSS pixels.

parameters.name: Inline
parameters.description: Renders in place instead of portalling. A host that supplies its own dialog sets this.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Forced layout. Mobile presents the picker as the core sheet.

parameters.name: ShowRemove
parameters.description: Shows the Remove action. Off unless the host can clear an icon.

parameters.name: RecentEmojis
parameters.description: Recent emoji to render first. Null reads them from localStorage.

parameters.name: OnEmojiSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects an emoji. The argument is the emoji character.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the picker is dismissed without a selection.
